snippet.title: 鋼鉄霊域　スティールダム (Koutetsu Reiiki: Steeldom). [PlayStation - TechnoSoft]. (1996). Misaki & Kiria Plays.
snippet.description:
.Played by PiE. - "December 16th, 2023".
.
.INFO.
3D action game with shooting elements together. Choose one of the eight characters from the action, shoot, throw, slash, smash the enemy to make full use of a variety of actions such as throwing. Horizontal movement during "teleport" and the introduction of the fighting has to be speedy.
..
.DISCLAIMER.
Some Games On this Channel use Save States. NO TAS, NO CHEATS are used.
.
